responseText:
Take those basic gathering tools I gave ya and get yourself out into the wilderness, the foothills around the old Veinbreaker Mines are a good spot, but for the love of all stone, stay out of the mine entrance itself! It's crawling with those hostile Clay Dwarves. Stick to the surface, where it's a bit safer. Bring me back a small bundle of useful materials, and show me you can provide for yourself. 

It'll show you've got the knack for it, and I'll rest easy knowing you can feed yourself!
name: ANV_FTUE_Dunir_GarrimHammersong_7_Response
